inner_validation_rule: last 252 Mon-Fri origin positions ending at latest mature outer training origin
inner_purge_rule: all three labels available before first inner validation decision
checkpoint_rule: minimum inner validation loss among completed epochs; min_delta controls patience only
selection_rule: seed 42 mean MAE/persistence MAE over six blocks and three horizons, equal cell weights; tie A
stability_rule: one selected variant per architecture, reuse seed 42 and add 123/2026; never select a seed
